title: Three carnivals and how they worked
summary: After Rock Dinah he worked three carnivals with their own Pullman, privilege and gambling cars; musicians were nobodies.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh yeah. Rock Dinah was no carnival; that was a road show, a TOBA show. And then I was on Greater Sheesley, and then... I was on three carnivals, Beckmann and Garrity(?) and C.A. Worthen. Yeah.
And when you call them carnivals, what... Where did they work? Like, tents and stuff like that?

It was like a circus. But I'm going to tell you one thing. Those carnivals in those days were first class, man. They had their own Pullman cars, they had their own privilege car where you ate at, they had the gambling car. And it was really first-class operation, you know. Of course, I mean, the stars made money, but you know...
Well, the musicians were nobody. A kid could come like me, and couldn't get arrested. I finally quit that show down in... That's the one I quit in Little Rock.
